eventDetail.scope: The theme of IConAECC 2026 is "Innovations for Sustainable Development." The conference aims to serve as a platform for researchers, academia, and industry to share knowledge across various disciplines in Electrical, Communication, and Computer Science. Additionally, IConAECC 2026 will provide a forum for world-class researchers to come together and share their research achievements, ideas, and progress in addressing future challenges in these fields.
